nodes.label: Gates 6/7/8 Completion Evidence
nodes.description: Gates 6/7/8 CLOSED (source). Gate 6: guest draft memory-only, authenticated save state machine, real time ranges, query identity with authorizationScope, sample limit policy. Gate 7: AlertService creates alert + alert.triggered in one DB::transaction, AlertObserver removed sync broadcast, DomainEventBroadcastConsumer handles alert.triggered with idempotent redelivery, frontend bounded seenTriggeredIds/seenResolvedIds ledgers, recovery buffers resolved events. Gate 8: DeviceService.changeStatus() records immutable fact, DomainEventBroadcastConsumer broadcasts with eventSequence, frontend sequence-guarded projection. Frontend: 128 tests, 0 failures. Open GAP: backend runtime, MySQL EXPLAIN, browser/network audit.
nodes.rationale: Documents the completion of the three intermediate gates. Gate 6 establishes the public graph boundary, Gate 7 the alert lifecycle, and Gate 8 the device status projection. Each gate builds on the previous.
